items.title: Bill Allred interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: we’d do orchestral things for Ray Charles and we did a dozen shows with Ray... I played in those you know.

ctx.x: Because there’s no, there’s no comp — there’s no more downtown this and downtown that. Like at Rosie O’Grady’s, when Rosie O’Grady’s was running in downtown Orlando, and when Disney was cranking with all their bands and stuff, I mean the musical climate in this town was un-freaking-believable. I mean and I was doing some contracting then where I’d, we’d do orchestral things for Ray Charles and we did a dozen shows with Ray. But you could get on the phone and come up with a band. I’ve put together a 53-piece…
